_comment: PT-N10 lists for neoforge-ledger (NeoForge mirror of plugin-ledger-forbidden-api.json; S1, S5, S9, S11 and the secrets rules). Edit this file, not the scanner. A name ending in '(' must be a call; any other name is matched as a whole word. Chat, sign, book and agent-text sinks are forbidden by default; a later card that must read one adds an allow entry with a reason.

allow.name: newInputStream(
allow.reason: Reads the ledger own properties file (the agent config path), never chat, agent or repo content.

allow.name: ServerChatEvent
allow.reason: PT-N8: the one chat listener (observation only: reads the text, never cancels or replies); owner-approved full-text capture D-F, cancelled messages skipped D-I.

allow.name: ServerChatEvent
allow.text: private static void chat(TextContentFamily text, net.neoforged.neoforge.event.ServerChatEvent e)
allow.reason: PT-N8: the parameter type of the same chat reader; no send, no setter.

allow.name: getRawText
allow.reason: PT-N8: the original typed chat text, immune to other mods decorating the message (a decorated text can carry the speaker name, D-F). The only chat read; getMessage and getUsername stay forbidden everywhere.

allow.name: FileChannel.open(
allow.reason: Reads only a life-id agent's own stats JSON: a path built from its UUID inside the world stats directory, a regular file, NOFOLLOW_LINKS, 256 KiB cap; never chat, agent or repo content.

allow.name: getMessage
allow.reason: java.util.logging LogRecord.getMessage of the ledger own log line (PT-N8 forbids getMessage for chat); not a chat read.
